desc: Prove that a GCD \(d\) is achievable for an occurrence of value \(x\) exactly when \(d\mid x\) and at least \(K\) values are divisible by \(d\).
Design the frequency-array and multiples-summing sieve under the \(N\le 1.2\times10^6\), \(A_i\le10^6\) limits.
Verify that descending divisor processing correctly assigns the maximum valid divisor to each value.
Implement and sample-test the full descending-divisor sieve with memory-conscious Python I/O.
Check edge cases including \(K=1\), duplicate values, all values equal, and cases where only GCD \(1\) is feasible.
